chunks.en: Do you travel for work a lot?
chunks.note: 跟同事閒聊時問對方常不常出差。a lot 放在句尾 = 常常。

distractors.text: Do you travels for work a lot?
Do you travel for work lot?
Do you travel for work a lots?

chunks.en: Which terminal does our flight leave from?
chunks.zh: 我們的班機是從第幾航廈出發？
accept: What terminal does our flight leave from?
chunks.note: 問班機從哪個航廈出發。主詞 our flight 是單數，用 does，leave 用原形。

distractors.text: Which terminal does our flight leaves from?
Which terminal our flight leaves from?
Which terminel does our flight leave from?

chunks.en: Could we get two seats together, please?
chunks.zh: 可以幫我們排兩個坐在一起的位子嗎？
accept: Can we get two seats together, please?
chunks.note: 在報到櫃台請地勤把同行的人排在一起。together 放在 seats 後面。

distractors.text: Could we get two seat together, please?
Could we two seats together, please?
Could we get two seats togather, please?

chunks.en: Is my suitcase over the weight limit?
chunks.note: 託運行李時問有沒有超重。over the limit = 超過上限。

distractors.text: Does my suitcase over the weight limit?
Is my suitcase over weight limit?
Is my suitcase over the wieght limit?

chunks.en: Sorry, I was looking for my boarding pass.
chunks.zh: 抱歉，我剛剛在找登機證。
chunks.note: 過去進行式 was／were + V-ing：說過去某段時間正在做的事。

distractors.text: Sorry, I was look for my boarding pass.
Sorry, I were looking for my boarding pass.
Sorry, I was looking my boarding pass.

chunks.en: We were standing in the wrong line the whole time.
chunks.zh: 我們從頭到尾都排錯隊了。
chunks.note: 主詞是 we，過去進行式用 were + V-ing。the whole time = 從頭到尾。

distractors.text: We was standing in the wrong line the whole time.
We were stand in the wrong line the whole time.
We were standing in wrong line the whole time.

chunks.en: Is this the latest version of our itinerary?
chunks.zh: 這是我們最新版的行程表嗎？
chunks.note: 收到更新的文件時，確認是不是最新的那一版。latest = 最新的。

distractors.text: Is this latest version of our itinerary?
Is this the latest versions of our itinerary?
Is this the latest version of our itinarary?

chunks.en: Do you have a new departure time yet?
chunks.zh: 請問新的起飛時間出來了嗎？
chunks.note: 班機延誤時問櫃台。yet 放在問句句尾 = 已經……了嗎。

distractors.text: Do you has a new departure time yet?
Do you have new departure time yet?
Do you have a new departure time already yet?

chunks.en: Is it possible to catch an earlier flight?
chunks.zh: 有沒有可能改搭早一點的班機？
chunks.note: 問能不能改搭別班。Is it possible to + 動詞原形 = 有可能……嗎？

distractors.text: Is it possible catch an earlier flight?
Is it possible to catch a earlier flight?
Is it possible to catching an earlier flight?

chunks.en: Do we have time to eat before we board?
chunks.zh: 登機前我們還來得及吃點東西嗎？
chunks.note: 時間子句 before：before 後面接完整的句子（we board），表示「在……之前」。

distractors.text: Do we have time eat before we board?
Do we have time to eat before we boarding?
Do we have time to eat before board we?

chunks.en: Let's wait here until they post the new gate.
chunks.zh: 我們在這裡等到新的登機門公布吧。
chunks.note: 時間子句 until：一直……到某件事發生為止。until 後面接完整的句子，不用 will。

distractors.text: Let's wait here until they will post the new gate.
Let's waiting here until they post the new gate.
Let's wait here until they post new gate.

chunks.en: Did they say gate thirteen or gate thirty?
chunks.zh: 他們剛剛是說 13 號還是 30 號登機門？
accept: Did they say gate 13 or gate 30?
chunks.note: 廣播沒聽清楚時跟同伴確認。thirteen 重音在後面，thirty 重音在前面。

distractors.text: Did they said gate thirteen or gate thirty?
Did they say gate thirteen or gate thirthy?
They did say gate thirteen or gate thirty?

chunks.en: Do you want the window seat or the aisle?
chunks.zh: 你想坐靠窗還是靠走道？
chunks.note: 找到座位時問同伴想坐哪裡。aisle 的 s 不發音，念起來像 I'll。

distractors.text: Do you wants the window seat or the aisle?
Do you want the window seat or the isle?
Do you want window seat or the aisle?

chunks.en: I'll call Ms. Carter as soon as we land.
chunks.zh: 我們一落地，我就打給 Ms. Carter。
accept: I will call Ms. Carter as soon as we land.
chunks.note: 說好落地後馬上要做的事。as soon as 後面用現在式，不用 will。

distractors.text: I'll call Ms. Carter as soon as we will land.
I'll call Ms. Carter as soon we land.
I'll calling Ms. Carter as soon as we land.

words.zh: （航空公司的）地勤人員；櫃台人員
任何地方；到處（都找不到）
伸展（stretch my legs 起來走一走）
服務員（flight attendant 空服員）
頭頂上方的（座位上方的置物櫃）

pairs.note: sea 嘴角往兩邊拉，舌尖在牙齒後面；she 嘴唇往前噘成圓形，聲音比較低沉。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here we are at the airport. Your first business trip!
scene.zh: 到機場了。你第一次出差耶！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you travel for work a lot?
scene.zh: 你常出差嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Pretty often. I fly to Chicago two or three times a year.
scene.zh: 滿常的。我一年要飛芝加哥兩三次。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: After a few trips, you'll do all this easily.
scene.zh: 多跑幾趟，這些你就駕輕就熟了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which terminal does our flight leave from?
scene.zh: 我們的班機是從第幾航廈出發？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Terminal B. We can take the airport train from here.
scene.zh: B 航廈。我們可以從這裡搭機場電車過去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's free, and it comes every five minutes.
scene.zh: 免費的，而且每五分鐘就一班。

fills.en: Please ask the ___ at the counter for a new boarding pass.
fills.zh: 請找櫃台的地勤人員拿一張新的登機證。
fills.note: 在櫃台幫你辦手續的人是 agent。

fills.en: My ID ___ next month, but it is still valid today.
fills.zh: 我的證件下個月到期，不過今天還是有效的。
fills.note: 主詞 my ID 是單數，現在式動詞加 s。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning. Flight 482. Is Chicago your final destination today?
scene.zh: 早安。482 班機，請問您今天的目的地就是芝加哥嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay. Can I see both of your IDs, please?
scene.zh: 好的。可以看一下兩位的證件嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yours expires next month, but it's still valid today.
scene.zh: 您的證件下個月到期，不過今天還是有效的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could we get two seats together, please?
scene.zh: 可以幫我們排兩個坐在一起的位子嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. I have a window and an aisle seat together.
scene.zh: 沒問題。我這裡有靠窗和靠走道連在一起的位子。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Are you checking any luggage today?
scene.zh: 今天有要託運行李嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is my suitcase over the weight limit?
scene.zh: 我的行李箱有超重嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No, it's under the limit for domestic flights. Here are your boarding passes.
scene.zh: 沒有，沒超過國內線的上限。這是兩位的登機證。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There you are! I couldn't see you anywhere.
scene.zh: 你在這裡！我到處都看不到你。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, I was looking for my boarding pass.
scene.zh: 抱歉，我剛剛在找登機證。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Was it in your pocket? Keep it in your wallet next time.
scene.zh: 在口袋裡嗎？下次收在皮夾裡啦。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Wait. That guard says this line is for crew only.
scene.zh: 等一下，那個警衛說這一排只給機組人員走。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We were standing in the wrong line the whole time.
scene.zh: 我們從頭到尾都排錯隊了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My fault. I wasn't paying attention.
scene.zh: 我的錯，我沒注意看。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let's go straight to the line behind those tourists.
scene.zh: 我們直接去排那群觀光客後面那一排吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And take off your belt before security.
scene.zh: 還有，過安檢前先把皮帶拿下來。

passages.title: New version of your itinerary
lines: The airline changed the time of your flight home on Saturday evening, so I'm sending you a new version of your itinerary. Please use this one, not the old one.
Your departure today is the same. Flight 482 leaves at 1:10 p.m., and the arrival time in Chicago is 3:05 p.m.
There may be a storm near Chicago this afternoon, so there is a possibility of a delay. If anything unexpected happens, call me.
You don't need a rental car. A free shuttle goes from the airport to where you're staying every 30 minutes, so you can get there easily.

questions.en: Why did Ms. Carter write this email?
questions.zh: Ms. Carter 為什麼寫這封信？

questions.en: How will they leave the airport?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Check your email. Ms. Carter just sent us something.
scene.zh: 你看一下信箱，Ms. Carter 剛寄東西給我們。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is this the latest version of our itinerary?
scene.zh: 這是我們最新版的行程表嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. The airline changed our flight home on Saturday.
scene.zh: 對。航空公司改了我們星期六回程的班機。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Our departure today is the same, at one ten.
scene.zh: 今天的出發時間不變，一點十分。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But there's a storm near Chicago this afternoon.
scene.zh: 不過今天下午芝加哥附近有暴風雨。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So there's a real possibility we'll be late.
scene.zh: 所以我們很有可能會晚到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: At least we don't need a rental car. There's a free shuttle.
scene.zh: 還好我們不用租車，有免費的接駁車。

lines.en: Hi. Our flight to Chicago is delayed. What's going on?
lines.zh: 你好。我們往芝加哥的班機延誤了，是怎麼回事？

lines.en: The plane is still on the ground in Chicago because of the weather.
lines.zh: 因為天氣的關係，飛機還停在芝加哥的地面上。

lines.en: I see. When do you think it will depart?
lines.zh: 了解。你覺得大概什麼時候會起飛？

lines.en: It's still unclear, but we hope to leave around two thirty.
lines.zh: 現在還不確定，不過我們希望兩點半左右可以起飛。

lines.en: Okay. Can we wait in the lounge?
lines.zh: 好。我們可以去貴賓室等嗎？

lines.en: Sorry, the lounge is only for members. There's a coffee shop next to this gate.
lines.zh: 抱歉，貴賓室只開放給會員。這個登機門旁邊有一家咖啡店。
太好了，我們就在那裡等。

lines.en: Just please don't go too far.

questions.zh: 班機大概什麼時候會起飛？

questions.en: Where does the agent tell them to wait?
questions.zh: 地勤建議他們在哪裡等？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi there. Are you asking about the Chicago flight?
scene.zh: 你好。是要問往芝加哥的班機嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you have a new departure time yet?
scene.zh: 請問新的起飛時間出來了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not yet, sorry. The plane is still on the ground in Chicago.
scene.zh: 還沒有，不好意思。飛機還停在芝加哥的地面上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The weather there is bad, so it's unclear right now.
scene.zh: 那邊天氣很差，所以現在還說不準。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We're hoping it can depart around two thirty.
scene.zh: 我們希望兩點半左右可以起飛。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is it possible to catch an earlier flight?
scene.zh: 有沒有可能改搭早一點的班機？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm afraid the twelve forty is full. I can't add any more passengers.
scene.zh: 恐怕十二點四十那班已經滿了，沒辦法再加乘客。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Please stay near the gate. I'll know more soon.
scene.zh: 請待在登機門附近，我很快會有新的消息。

textFills.title: Flight 482 Update
lines: Flight 482 to Chicago is delayed because of bad weather. The plane will depart from a new gate.
Please stay near this gate ___ we post the new gate on the screens.
If you are one of our frequent passengers, you are welcome to wait in our ___.
zh: 往芝加哥的 482 班機因為天氣不好延誤了，飛機會改從新的登機門起飛。
在我們把新的登機門公布在螢幕上之前，請待在這個登機門附近。
常搭我們班機的旅客，歡迎到我們的貴賓室等候。

blanks.note: 一直等到公布為止，用 until。
可以坐著等的地方是貴賓室 lounge。
for 後面的動詞要用 V-ing。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Still cloudy out there. This could be a long wait.
scene.zh: 外面還是陰陰的。可能要等很久喔。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do we have time to eat before we board?
scene.zh: 登機前我們還來得及吃點東西嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Everything here is open except the pizza place.
scene.zh: 可以啊。這裡除了披薩店，其他都有開。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hold on. They just announced a gate change.
scene.zh: 等一下，他們剛剛廣播說要換登機門。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But the screen doesn't say which gate yet.
scene.zh: 可是螢幕上還沒寫是哪個登機門。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's wait here until they post the new gate.
scene.zh: 我們在這裡等到新的登機門公布吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea. I'll stretch my legs and get us some sandwiches.
scene.zh: 好主意。我起來走一走，順便買兩個三明治。

lines.en: Attention, please. This is an announcement for passengers on Flight 482 to Chicago.
lines.zh: 各位旅客請注意，這是往芝加哥 482 班機的廣播。

lines.en: Your flight will now leave from gate thirty, on the opposite side of the terminal.
lines.zh: 您的班機改從 30 號登機門出發，在航廈的另一邊。

lines.en: Boarding will begin at two o'clock, starting with group one.
lines.zh: 兩點開始登機，從第一組開始。

lines.en: Space in the cabin is limited, so please bring only one bag on board.
lines.zh: 機艙空間有限，請每人只帶一件行李上機。

lines.en: Our flight attendants will be happy to help you.
lines.zh: 我們的空服員很樂意協助您。

lines.en: Please keep your valuables with you at all times.
lines.zh: 請隨時把貴重物品帶在身上。

lines.en: Leaving your baggage unattended is prohibited.
lines.zh: 行李不可以放著無人看管。

lines.en: Thank you for your cooperation. We hope to get you to Chicago safely.
lines.zh: 謝謝您的配合，我們希望讓您平安抵達芝加哥。

questions.en: Which gate will the flight leave from?
questions.zh: 班機改從幾號登機門出發？

questions.en: What does the announcement ask passengers not to do?
questions.zh: 廣播請旅客不要做什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Wait, that announcement was for us. We're changing gates.
scene.zh: 等等，剛剛那個廣播是在說我們。我們要換登機門。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Did they say gate thirteen or gate thirty?
scene.zh: 他們剛剛是說 13 號還是 30 號登機門？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thirty. It's all the way on the opposite side.
scene.zh: 30 號。在另一頭，很遠。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Boarding starts at two, so we should go now.
scene.zh: 兩點就開始登機了，我們現在就該走了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Keep your wallet and phone with you, okay?
scene.zh: 皮夾和手機要帶在身上喔。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And only one bag in the cabin, they said. Mine might be too big!
scene.zh: 他們還說機艙裡只能帶一件行李。我的可能太大了！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's row twelve. Hurry, people are waiting.
scene.zh: 12 排在這裡。快點，後面有人在等。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you want the window seat or the aisle?
scene.zh: 你想坐靠窗還是靠走道？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You take the window. I like the aisle.
scene.zh: 你坐靠窗吧，我喜歡靠走道。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll put your bag in the overhead.
scene.zh: 我幫你把包包放到上面的置物櫃。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The pilot says it'll be a smooth flight.
scene.zh: 機長說這趟應該會飛得很平穩。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And look, we're right by the exit.
scene.zh: 而且你看，我們就在出口旁邊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll call Ms. Carter as soon as we land.
scene.zh: 我們一落地，我就打給 Ms. Carter。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. She'll want to know we're safe.
scene.zh: 好。她會想知道我們平安到了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ms. Carter sent our travel plans again. Check your email.
scene.zh: Ms. Carter 又寄了一次我們的行程，你看一下信箱。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is this the latest version of our itinerary?
scene.zh: 這是我們最新版的行程表嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Wait, our flight's delayed. Let's ask at the counter.
scene.zh: 對。等等，我們的班機延誤了。去櫃台問問看吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi. How can I help you two?
scene.zh: 你好，請問兩位需要什麼協助？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you have a new departure time yet?
scene.zh: 請問新的起飛時間出來了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not yet. The plane is still on the ground because of the storm.
scene.zh: 還沒有。因為暴風雨，飛機還停在地面上。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is it possible to catch an earlier flight?
scene.zh: 有沒有可能改搭早一點的班機？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me check. Yes, I have two seats on the twelve forty.
scene.zh: 我查一下。有，十二點四十那班還有兩個位子。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could we get two seats together, please?
scene.zh: 可以幫我們排兩個坐在一起的位子嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, just a window and an aisle. Can I see your boarding passes?
scene.zh: 抱歉，只剩一個靠窗、一個靠走道。可以看一下兩位的登機證嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, I was looking for my boarding pass.
scene.zh: 抱歉，我剛剛在找登機證。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem. Here are your new ones. You board in twenty minutes.
scene.zh: 沒關係。這是新的登機證，二十分鐘後登機。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Twenty minutes. I could really eat something.
scene.zh: 二十分鐘啊。我好想吃點東西。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do we have time to eat before we board?
scene.zh: 登機前我們還來得及吃點東西嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Just a quick sandwich. Wait, listen. They're announcing our gate.
scene.zh: 只能吃個三明治。等等，你聽，他們在廣播我們的登機門。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Did they say gate thirteen or gate thirty?
scene.zh: 他們剛剛是說 13 號還是 30 號登機門？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thirteen. That's a short distance from here. I know this airport well.
scene.zh: 13 號，離這裡很近。這個機場我很熟。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you travel for work a lot?
scene.zh: 你常出差嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Pretty often, and sometimes abroad. Someone should tell Ms. Carter about our new flight.
scene.zh: 滿常的，有時候還會出國。對了，要有人跟 Ms. Carter 說我們換班機了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll call Ms. Carter as soon as we land.
scene.zh: 我們一落地，我就打給 Ms. Carter。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Now let's go get that sandwich.
scene.zh: 太好了。那我們去買三明治吧。
